a.xlink:title: Owns every sensor driver and publishes their readings each cycle.
Reads three BMI323 IMUs and votes them into one acceleration and rate.
One BMI323 accelerometer and gyroscope, configured for flight.
One IMU reading in the sensor's own axes.
SPI context passed to the Bosch driver callbacks as intf_ptr.
ISM6HG256X accelerometer, high-g accelerometer and gyroscope.
One averaged ISM6HG256X reading.
Two-out-of-three voting for 3-axis readings. Used for the IMUs.
Per-sensor status from IMUs::Init() and IMUs::Update(). 0 means OK.
Reads three BMP390 barometers on SPI2 and votes each quantity.
One BMP390 barometer, configured for flight.
SPI context passed to the Bosch driver callbacks as intf_ptr.
One barometer reading.
Readings from each barometer plus the voted result.
Per-sensor status codes from Barometer::Init() or Barometer::Update(). 0 means OK.
MAX-M10S GPS: reads NMEA over I2C and parses it with TinyGPSPlus.
Latest GPS solution. Fields keep their last valid values until updated.
Both canard servos: open-loop PWM commands and analog angle feedback.
Settings shared by both servos.
Commands, feedback and status for both servos.
LIS2MDL magnetometer: 100 Hz continuous mode with temperature compensation.
One magnetometer reading.
